oracle.description: Coordinator-authored tests in templates/dispatch/tests/test_session_notes.py define correctness for session_notes.py: append/list mechanics, supersedes-chain head resolution (concurrent heads, dangling refs, cycles), and cross-repo latest resolution.

purpose: Implement templates/dispatch/scripts/session_notes.py and templates/dispatch/skills/session-handover/SKILL.md per the ratified session-note-contract-plan.md Phase 1 design, so the frozen coordinator-authored test suite passes. The schema, example, validator discovery, and matrix row already shipped in #1213; this packet implements only the writer/reader script and the skill doc, matching AgentOps backlog item #1280 (bulk-admissible slice: bounded script/skill mechanics).
required_outcomes: session_notes.py exposes new_note(), append(), load_notes(), resolve_latest(), resolve_latest_multi(), and list_notes() importable functions matching the exact behavior asserted by test_session_notes.py
session_notes.py exposes an argparse CLI with append/latest/list subcommands (cmd_append, cmd_latest, cmd_list) mirroring the sibling session_scribe.py conventions
every written note validates via the existing validate_session_mechanization_artifacts.VALIDATOR.validate_session_note before being persisted
the frozen oracle test suite (templates/dispatch/tests/test_session_notes.py) passes unmodified

the session-handover skill doc explains writing a note at session end/clear and reading `latest` at session start, per session-note-contract-plan.md's Phase 1 skill scope (no hook wiring -- that is #1281)

acceptance_properties.requirement: session_notes.py implements the frozen oracle's append/list/supersedes-resolution/cross-repo-latest contract
acceptance_properties.fails_when: any function in test_session_notes.py is missing, has the wrong signature, or produces output that does not match the frozen assertions

non_goals: editing the schema, example, or validator (already shipped in #1213)
editing docs, the manifest, or any file outside writable_patch_paths
